name: Camp Deerwood
description_short: Deerwood is an overnight camp for boys aged 8-15 on Squam Lake in Holderness, New Hampshire. Along with traditional camp activities, campers can try blacksmithing, waterskiing, rock climbing, kayaking, mountain biking and windsurfing.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is on Squam Lake; waterfront activities include waterskiing, kayaking and windsurfing.
